**Best Move: Re8+**

This gives check, forcing the Black king to move and activating White's rook with tempo. After the king moves (say Kd5), White's rook controls the e-file and the position becomes winning—Black's rook and king lack coordination while White's pawns advance with support.

**Coaching Note:**
Look for forcing moves with your rook—especially checks that improve your piece activity. Here, Re8+ doesn't just give check; it gains time to activate your rook on a powerful file. With a superior position, checks that also improve your pieces are usually stronger than passive moves like h4. Train yourself to spot how forcing moves combine benefit with tempo.
